blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The source is a self-contained browser canvas free-roam stunt game. The player moves through a 5000x5000 world with a left-thumb joystick, gains speed on the ground, hits rectangular ramps/gates to launch into the air, taps one of three trick buttons while airborne, and earns score only after landing cleanly. Thorn hazards bounce the avatar into air and can force a fumble. The player can end the run manually and restart from an overlay.

## Protected Mechanics
- One-thumb joystick movement on the left side of the portrait viewport.
- Three right-side trick buttons, usable only while airborne and not already tricking.
- Ground acceleration, friction, speed cap, camera follow, air gravity, and world bounds.
- Gate/ramp launch threshold and rotated rectangle collision semantics.
- Thorn obstacle bounce and forced airborne hazard feedback.
- Clean landing score: combo count times 100; unfinished trick on landing fumbles and cancels combo.
- Manual run-end overlay and restart reset flow.

## Remixed Canonical Runtime
`index.html` is rebuilt as **Midnight Cloutline: Vampire Open World Survival**, a satirical gothcore open-world survival sprint where a vampire courier roams an analog-horror city, hits neon stunt alleys, performs meme/bite/lore drops in air, and banks cursed clout on clean landings.

## Transformable Surfaces
HUD language, fonts, palette, focal silhouette, ramp/hazard visuals, procedural background, particles, feedback copy, audio selection, and modal language are transformed while preserving the mechanics above.
